_about: Daily source watch (scripts/watch_sources.py, .github/workflows/source-watch.yml; owner order 2026-11-26 (13)). One entry per page to watch: its URL, and what to watch on it as `rules`. A rule that no longer holds opens ONE GitHub issue per watch (the owner gets the mail); nothing is published or switched on by the job. Rule kinds: present (the text must still be on the page), absent (the text must not be on the page), unchanged (the page's text between `from` and `to` must equal the committed baseline). New kinds go in scripts/watch_sources.py RULES. Write a baseline for an unchanged rule: python -m scripts.watch_sources --write-baseline <id>.
